skill.name: uniswap
skill.description: Use Ape and uniswap-sdk to plan Uniswap pricing, routing, swaps, and Silverback bot integrations in Python.
skill.summary: Guide Python Uniswap workflows with Ape, tokenlists, route indexing, price checks, and cautious trade steps.
skill.author: ApeWorX

security_audit.summary: No malware, prompt injection attempt, credential access, or unauthorized exfiltration was found. The shell execution alerts are Markdown formatting false positives, while the skill does require low-risk public documentation fetches and includes medium financial risk because Uniswap trades can move user funds.

remediation.issue: External documentation fetches are required before code generation.
remediation.suggestion: Limit fetching to the listed ApeWorX and Ape documentation pages, review remote content before using it, and never include secrets in fetch prompts or URLs.

remediation.issue: Uniswap swap workflows can transfer real funds.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval with network, token addresses, amount, route, quote, slippage, gas estimate, and recipient before any transaction is submitted.

remediation.issue: Token and route selection can cause financial loss if stale or incorrect.
remediation.suggestion: Verify token contracts through trusted tokenlists, query live prices, and keep the small test swap requirement for new or large trades.

content.value_statement: Uniswap integrations require current Ape, account, and tokenlist setup knowledge. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through documented Uniswap SDK workflows for routing, pricing, trades, and Silverback bots.
actual_capabilities: Directs agents to fetch current uniswap-sdk, Ape, and ape-tokens documentation before writing code.
Helps identify the target network, swap tokens, price queries, and useful intermediate routing tokens.
Guides Uniswap pair indexing with uni.index or uni.install before route and liquidity checks.
Prompts price checks, user confirmation, and small test swaps before risky trades.
Supports planning Silverback bot integrations that use the SDK instead of custom Uniswap logic.
limitations: Requires Python, Ape, configured Ape accounts, and tokenlist support outside the skill file.
Depends on external documentation and network access for current implementation details.
Does not remove market, slippage, liquidity, gas, or smart contract risk.
Does not include complete implementation examples; agents must consult current documentation.

prompt_templates.title: Check Setup Requirements
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uniswap skill to identify the Ape, account, Python, and tokenlist prerequisites for using Uniswap on my chosen network. Do not plan a transaction yet.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Price Query
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uniswap skill to fetch current documentation and outline how to query a token pair price on my chosen network. Include the checks needed before any trade.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Cautious Swap
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uniswap skill to design a cautious swap workflow from one token to another. Include route indexing, price checks, slippage review, and explicit approval steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Silverback Integration
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the uniswap skill to plan a Silverback bot integration that indexes pairs, monitors liquidity, and proposes routes without executing trades until I approve them.

output_examples.input: I want to check USDC to WETH routes on Base.
output: Fetches current Uniswap SDK and Ape documentation.
Confirms Base network setup, token availability, and tokenlist requirements.
Outlines route indexing, price checks, and approval points before any transaction.

output_examples.input: Help me add Uniswap support to a Silverback bot.
output_examples.output: The skill produces a plan for using the SDK, indexing pairs, keeping live pool data available, and avoiding custom routing logic.

output_examples.input: I need a safe process before a large swap.
output: Query the price and route first.
Verify token contracts, amount, slippage, gas, and network.
Run a small test swap before considering the larger trade.

best_practices: Fetch current official documentation before generating implementation details.
Query price and route data before any transaction, then get explicit user approval.
Test new or large swaps with a small amount and verify token and network choices.
anti_patterns: Relying on stale general knowledge instead of current Ape and SDK documentation.
Executing large swaps without quotes, route review, slippage checks, and user approval.
Writing custom Uniswap routing logic when the SDK and Silverback integration already cover it.

faq.question: Does this skill execute trades by itself?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance for using Ape and uniswap-sdk. Any transaction still requires tool access and user-approved execution.

faq.question: What tools are required?
faq.answer: The skill expects Python, Ape, configured Ape accounts, and tokenlist support through ape-tokens.

faq.question: Why does it fetch documentation first?
faq.answer: Ape, uniswap-sdk, and tokenlist workflows can change. Current documentation reduces stale implementation advice.

faq.question: Can it help choose route tokens?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks the agent to consider network-specific tokens, wrapped native assets, and liquid stablecoins as possible route steps.

faq.question: Is it safe for large trades?
faq.answer: Large trades remain risky. The skill recommends price checks, user confirmation, and a small test swap first.

faq.question: Does it support Silverback bots?
faq.answer: Yes. It describes using the SDK inside Silverback bots for pair indexing, route discovery, and liquidity-aware workflows.
